answer: An agent marketplace requires a fixed bond locked for 30 days for each active bidding slot, whether the job is pricing onyx, designing a trellis, or sourcing umber pigment. Creating new identities grants no free slots: each must post the same bond before bidding. An attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous slots must immobilize 1,000 bonds for a month, so splitting one budget among fake agents cannot increase its bidding capacity.
